independent_oracles: Every hostile claim family starts from issuer-created positive and independently verifies ES256/issuer/audience with jsonwebtoken, then verifies an unchanged same-signer reconstruction before mutation. No wrong-key/shape false negative is accepted as proof.

Independent wire keyset, fixed audience/kind, canonical decimal generation, UUIDs, primary metadata, maximum lifetime and fresh jti are checked. Positive access outcomes are explicitly Current; expired outcomes are independently matched later.

Raw duplicate required Account/CSRF fields are emitted by custom serde SerializeMap directly into jsonwebtoken::encode. Each raw serialized body asserts two member occurrences before signing, without Value parse collapse. Legacy duplicate/marker compatibility is a separately owned Fast candidate and excluded here.

Current/Expired validation does not have a DB. Valid expired access retains exact Account/family/generation/expiry for future authority checks; wrong signature/issuer/audience/kind/UUID/generation/causal times remains fixed InvalidToken even when expired. CSRF expiry is fixed ExpiredSignature.

Time uses one trusted fixture clock per fixture. Verifier receives explicit trusted now; expiry boundary advances that argument rather than sleeping. Independent decoder disables library wall-clock expiry/nbf solely for signed wire inspection, while implementation must enforce all actual limits itself.

No zero/negative configured access TTL or family ceiling. Access is bounded by configured TTL/15minutes/family; proof by5minutes/family. Near9999-12-31 valid8second ceiling with i64MAX configured duration detects overflow-before-clamp. Empty configured issuer must fail safe.

Token/claims/access-outcome Debug cannot reveal encoded segments or Account/family/issuer values. Invalid-input errors must be fixed InvalidToken and neither Debug nor Display may echo signed token segments, hostile known claim VALUE or hostile unknown FIELD NAME. Unknown-field-name canary covers both protocols without the former CSRF unknown-value vacuity. Ephemeral keys/tokens stay memory-only and out of messages.
